rows.text: **Rs 38.88 cr** (Rs 3,888.07 lakh, exclusive of taxes) of pre-finished wooden doors and frames with installation for **Oberoi Realty and Incline Realty**, delivery by 31-Dec-2026, across Oberoi Elysian Towers A/B and Skycity Towers F/G. Unexecuted order book past **Rs 170 cr** at 31-Jul-2026 (~51% of mcap — *not* the ~14% the baseline printed).
